subject: Make ARC ON-arm Zonoid prompt-driven (de-rig harness auto-memory)
description: Per user direction: the ON-arm Zonoid usage should test generalization, not be a hand-built harness feature. Replace the rigged harness auto-machinery with a system-prompt memory protocol the agent itself follows. (1) adapter.py zonoid_task_instructions: rewrite into an agent-facing memory protocol — record before->action->after grid transitions as notes (POST /overlay/note), recall similar grids before deciding (GET /search), reuse transitions as evidence. (2) patches/arc-agi3-local-cli.patch regenerated: remove _zonoid_context_block (auto-fetch+inject) and _zonoid_record_observation (auto-write) and their call sites; inject ZONOID_TASK_INSTRUCTIONS into _build_system_prompt when zonoid active. Verified: patch applies clean on fresh arcprize/arc-agi-3-benchmarking clone; agent.py compiles; zero residual auto-machinery refs.
